pages.text: Welcome to the Heart Guide! This book contains information about all the beautiful girls you can find in the world of Mate.$(br2)Girls are special entities that can be captured, tamed, and cared for. Each girl has her own personality, abilities, and story.

Girls are divided into two main categories:$(br2)$(l:normal_girls)Normal Girls$(/l) - Friendly girls that spawn naturally in Girl Village.$(br)$(l:wild_girls)Wild Girls$(/l) - Feral girls that can be found in the wild.$(br2)Use the Master Ring to capture and tame girls!
